What is implemented:
1. Frozen exact STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR=1 defaultOFF. Absent/0/01/true/other flag values remain existing chunk-major. Strict frozen STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR_R_GPU is mandatory when enabled: unsigned decimal0..262144, no sign/space/suffix/base/overflow; invalid parse does not publish an output value. Existing --vram-reserve-mib must be explicitly supplied positive, preventing existing automatic reserve reduction; Prefill API has set_layer_major_reserve(bytes), mandatory for direct enabled API calls.
2. Raw generate admission before model/device allocation: fresh standalone only; no serve/batch/MTP/pipeline/split/helper/vision/full-context probe/phase cache/streamed or growing KV/elastic VRAM/borrowed workspace/automatic or partial prefill/adaptive swaps. R_GPU must fit actual conditioning prefix (ordinary prompt P reads P-1 in Prefill). Additional init guard before workspace allocations checks full session ordinals/layer range/shape/resident KV, explicit prefix/reserve, in-order Runtime compute queue, source/cache, no public callbacks/vision/borrow. Intermediate residual dump/NaN/state-hash modes are rejected to avoid treating per-layer intermediate rows as final diagnostics.
3. Existing Prefill::run moved to private run_impl without kernel/math/dtype implementation changes; new public run dispatches frozen mode. Existing chunk-major behavior remains default. Layer-major calls current run_impl over one layer's complete n chunks, then advances to next layer. Current GDN/QSA ordinal offset initialization (count layers before LB) and persistent states remain authoritative.
4. Production host layout validates n>0/n<=262144, pos0=0, physical context<=262144/span, positive chunk/width/source blob, bounded layer/expert counts and reserve; checked uint64/size_t products/sums and signed ExpertCache extent. GPU residual prefix rounds DOWN to fixed chunk boundaries; all n includes final short complete chunk. Reject rawprefix>actualn; never silently clamp/downsize requested memory. Chunk store checks row/count/range/store boundary and computes exact GPU/host-tail offsets. Full FP32 residual rows persist in device prefix and pageable RAM tail.
5. At run boundary checked existing compute/copy drain and stager finish; fresh gpu::mem_info and cgroup-aware detail::host_available_memory must admit bridge + newone-layercache + explicitreserve. Existing model/head/session/ordinarycache/workspace already charged in fresh samples; do not subtract them twice. Host budget includes bridge+one maxblob staging+fullmodelresidency table+reserve. Lazy kernel/provider and small metadata peaks consume explicitreserve; this is a requested-byte preflight, not physical peak proof. Failure never reduces reserve/prefix automatically. Vector max_size and source per-layer byte extents checked. Device allocation can still fail and returns an error.
6. New ExpertCache::open_sized(g.n_expert max-blob-sized aligned slots,1,g.n_expert). Current slot API metadata/extents used. Per layer, all actualexpert blobs upload once (512 for current model); currentlayout.blob_bytes(layer)>0<=MAXBLOB checked. Stable/nontransient source blob() called on issuer thread and immediately copied through checked synchronous gpu::copy before next blob() call (which may invalidate pointer). Transient source uses copy_blob into one bounded host buffer, then checked copy completes before reuse. Nullsource/nullslot/sourceexception/copy_blob false rejected; unknown checkedGPU copy failure fail-stops without unwind. This deliberately serial source/copy loader avoids importing old stager/DMA assumptions; it may cost more loader time and requires later measured optimization.
7. Only completed layer upload publishes stack residency indices into newlayercache. Allchunks for thatlayer see those experts resident; current MMQ/fallback/cache gather/batching code stays active. Original decode expertcache and residency table are never rewritten. Previous layer compute completed before cache overwrite; no bare q.wait/dpct/native vendor identity added.
8. Each nonfirst layer reloads its residual chunk from GPU or RAMtail into current workspace on in-order m.cs. Layer0 uses original embedding. Intermediate layer internal on_chunk callback gets existing checked producer cs sync, then checked synchronous copy to bridge. Final layer leaves its last residual in normal workspace and completes allstate; no intermediate checkpoints are published. PLE prev[2] reset to original[-1,-1] for eachlayer; PLE history itself progresses only through its actuallayer, GDN/QSA through their actual ordinal states. Final ss.ple_prev reaches normal lasttwo tokens.
9. All owners declared before Restore. Restore destructor invokes shared production layer_major::retire: cancel/join-currentstager via finish, checkedcs/copydrains before restoring public callbacks/stage range/originalcache/stackresidency/residual pointers. Unknown drain invokes publication::cleanup_require(false)/_Exit74 BEFORE restoring/freeing owners. Device/cache destructors use current Runtime::free, which calls finish() then sycl::free and fatal on failure; open_sized's failedzero also uses thatcurrentclose path. Source/allocation exceptions unwind only after this guard drains. Existing run_impl exception handler still checks bothqueue drains before returning. A failed model session is not rolled back: caller must discard it, not resume another request.
10. Stats tokens/chunks counted only final layer; totalwall counted once outerguard including uploads/bridge/cleanup; expertstreamed/DMA counters account actualupload/pinning. STRATA_TRACE emits actual uploadedbytes/slots/chunks/store rows/role/checked completion perlayer, independent from existing GPU timer. New ADMITTED line gives actualhost/GPU bridge byteledger/cache/reserve/freshmemory and explicitprototype status. Diagnostic traces/timers are excluded from speed claims.

Important scope boundary / not complete:
This is the first resident-only prototype, not completion of the requested oldpath restoration through current stock streamed-KV262144. Unsupported features deliberately fail before allocations. Public on_chunk/on_stage_chunk/checkpoint callbacks are rejected, even though internally the bridge only runs after eachlayerchunk. This conservatively avoids snapshots where earlierlayers have consumed alln but laterlayers are only at an intermediatechunk. The initial implementation does NOT claim valid midprompt checkpoints, MTP, RESTORE/serve, split/helper or callback compatibility. It does NOT change current streamedKV to force allresident or secretly weaken current maxcontext. Full physical256K resident may not fit deviceheadroom; no launch attempted.
